title: Critique: proto-mentality does not explain human consciousness

statements.text: Positing an iota of mentality in basic particles or cells does not show how human consciousness, with its rationality, intentionality, rich qualities and agency, comes from it. Kim asks for an independently motivated principle saying what mentality a compound of given individuals in a given structure has.

sources.quote: But what I don’t see is how this really helps.
an independently motivated and defended principle
